messages:
Anna: Heads up — p95 on the latency dashboard for /v1/chat jumped ~400ms at 09:12 after we shifted traffic to a fallback routing for quota bursts. Anyone else seeing the same? :thinking:
Sam: I see it. Quick hypothesis: KV cache miss + different tokenization path on the fallback variant. Can you paste the dashboard query/filters you used?
Anna: sure — the widget query is: `SELECT p50(lat_ms), p95(lat_ms), p99(lat_ms) FROM latency WHERE endpoint='/v1/chat' AND env='prod' GROUP BY route, model_variant` and the time window was last 15m.
Kevin: UX note: the panel shows p50/p95/p99 but the legend doesn't call out which route contributed most of the p95 shift. That makes the spike look like a backend regression even when it's routing-related.
Marta: important: the sample_origin flips when we fallback. Gateway samples are labeled `gateway`, our fallback proxy labels samples `fallback-proxy`. The fallback path includes an extra tokenization step which adds ~300ms median in some cases.
Sam: I reproduced locally by applying a small fallback weight in the router sim. Steps: set fallback_weight=0.2 and send steady traffic. p95 shifts align with what Anna reported.
Sam: snippet of the rollout config I used: ```json
{"routing_policy": {"primary":"variant-a","fallback":"variant-b","fallback_weight":0.2}}
```
Anna: can we surface routing policy changes as event overlays on the chart? If the visual shows "fallback weight changed" at 09:12 it's less alarming.
Kevin: +1. Tooltip should also show sample-origin distribution for the selected time window (e.g., gateway: 75%, fallback-proxy: 25%).
Marta: quick mitigation option: compute and surface both `p95_all` and `p95_backend_only` (exclude samples with sample_origin in {gateway,fallback-proxy} as appropriate) so SREs can see attribution. But excluding samples affects SLO math — we need to call that out.
Anna: I don't want us to silently exclude real user impact. Showing both views (all vs backend-only) seems best for now.
Sam: agreed. Also proposal: when performing canary/weight changes, simulate expected metric delta by replaying a small recent trace set with the new routing mix and show expected percentile shifts in the rollout UI. That gives owners a preview before rolling.
Kevin: I can mock a tooltip that shows "expected p95 delta: +320ms (due to sample-origin shift)" and a miniature sparklines diff.
deploy-bot: rollout 2026-03-22T09:15Z: routing-fallback-weight-0.2 deployed to prod (id: rf-20260322-12)
Anna: thanks bot. Can someone turn this thread into an action list? I'll open an RFC referencing the replay idea.
Sam: I'll create a short plan in the docs: 1) annotate dashboards with routing events 2) add sample-origin breakdown in legend/tooltip 3) expose p95_backend view 4) add rollout-simulated-metric-delta in rollout UI 5) add tests to ensure sample-origin tagging survives proxy chains
Marta: I'll take validation ownership for telemetry once annotations exist; I'll run baseline checks and sign off on SLO implications.
Kevin: I'll push a UI mock by EOD and link it in the RFC. :thumbsup:
Anna: great, thanks everyone. Let's sync tomorrow 10:00 to finalize scope.
